TranslatedQuotation: If I have to move over short distances, then definitely Baseline. There is basically no question about that for me.
For short distances, I would choose Baseline; for medium to longer distances, Tsunami.
With the Minimap, you were completely detached from the surrounding space in the game.
I could also see more of the surrounding area, including streets. Suddenly, I was able to orient myself much better.
If the jitter were damped or smoothed a little more, it could also work quite well for precise movement over shorter distances.
When I released the joystick to teleport, it moved slightly and sent me to a somewhat different location from the one I had selected.
The Minimap was a little difficult at first, but once you got the hang of it, it actually worked quite well. Once it clicked, it was quite easy.
Tsunami was very straightforward and produced a good result. I personally liked it. It was relatively easy to use, especially for the tasks themselves, and I had no problems with it.
EvidentialRole: Experiential appeal combined with practical task use
